scope: Repeat only the interrupted native S- arm; original complete S+ is immutable read-only reference. Later reference arms only if frozen contrast is material.

rivals.A: Rerun one S- arm from frozen basal checkpoint and same 40+400 ms loader; unique directory; compare exact prepared state and full raw traces to existing S+.
rivals.B: Resume the 100-ms partial state with a new restoration implementation; requires independently verified exact state and contract, unavailable in the frozen runner.
rivals.C: Analyze only the 388-ms prefix; can diagnose timing or field separation but cannot meet the 400-ms preregistered gate.

selection_reason: Existing runner declares resumable_gaussian false; the prefix is incomplete and has NUL corruption after power loss. A changes no model or criterion.
frozen_experiment: Preserve original PLAN, SOURCE_LOCK, geometry, code, model, motor decoder, 40+400 ms clock and scientific thresholds unchanged.
stop: Stop on source/preparation/clock/consumer/budget failure; retain failures. Do not retune source, gain, model, thresholds or horizon. No Stage4 navigation claim from this gate.
existing_plus_reference_mechanism: Absolute symlink to immutable original completed S+; no data copied or new run implied. Export package must follow original explicitly.
